verdicts.reason: A keeps the right reading order (logo, eyebrow, headline, body, CTA). But it drops the architectural photo completely. The headline breaks one word per line at an oversized scale, the centred logo and CTA don't line up with the left-aligned text, and the CTA sits cramped against the bottom edge. B scrambles the hierarchy: the CTA is stranded at the top above the brand, the logo is blown up until it competes with the headline, and 'NOW OPEN' falls below the body copy and is rendered heavier than the body copy. The photo shrinks to a meaningless strip at the bottom with dead space above it.
